verses.text: A psalm by the sons of Korah. A song. God laid his foundation in the holy mountains.
The LORD loves Zion’s gates more than anywhere else Jacob’s people live.
City of God, people say glorious things about you! Selah.
“I’ll count Rahab and Babylon among those who know me. Look at Philistia, Tyre, and Ethiopia. I’ll say, ‘This one was born there.’”
People will say of Zion, “This one was born here, and so was that one.” The Most High himself will keep the city standing.
When the LORD writes down the names of the peoples, he’ll mark down, “This one was born there.” Selah.
Singers and dancers alike say, “All my springs are in you.”
